text: The Nominating Panel - Committee of Adjustment will conduct interviews and recommend 3 candidates to City Council for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment.

The Nominating Panel - Committee of Adjustment recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Committee of Adjustment for a term of office ending November 14, 2026, and until successors are appointed, as follows: North York Panel: Carl Knipfel Toronto and East York Panel: Ryan Bissonnette 2. City Council appoint the following candidate to the Committee of Adjustment - Scarborough Panel to fill a vacancy created by the leave of absence, for a term of office until the end of a leave, including up to the end of the term, November 14, 2026, and until a successor is appointed: Eric Hou
